title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Binary Arithmetic Function
statement: For a bit string $w$, let $x$ and $y$ be the first components of the second and first parsed pairs of $w$, respectively, and let $u$ and $v$ be the second components of those pairs. Define $F(w)$ by taking the binary representation of $\bigl((\max(\operatorname{val}(x)+\operatorname{val}(y)-((\operatorname{val}(u)\operatorname{val}(v))\bmod \operatorname{val}(y)),0))\bmod \operatorname{val}(y)\bigr)$, where an unsuccessful pair parse yields the empty string and $\operatorname{val}$ interprets the first bit as least significant. Then $F$ is computable in polynomial time by a finite Turing machine.
